arxiv-2011-13471.title: Towards Effective and Efficient Padding Machines for Tor
arxiv-2011-13471.creator: Tobias Pulls
arxiv-2011-13471.description: Abstract . Tor recently integrated a circuit padding framework for creating padding machines: defenses that work by defining state machines that inject dummy traffic to protect against traffic analysis attacks like Website Fingerprinting (WF) attacks. In this paper, we explore the design of effective and efficient padding machines to defend against WF attacks.

arxiv-2102-11638.title: ENHANCING DATA-FREE ADVERSARIAL DISTILLATION WITH ACTIVATION REGULARIZATION AND VIRTUAL INTERPOLATION
arxiv-2102-11638.creator: Xiaoyang Qu, Jianzong Wang, Jing Xiao
arxiv-2102-11638.description: Abstract Knowledge distillation refers to a technique of transferring the knowledge from a large learned model or an ensemble of learned models to a small model. This method relies on access to the original training set, which might not always be available.

arxiv-2202-07559.title: Unsupervised Learning of Group Invariant and Equivariant Representations
arxiv-2202-07559.creator: Robin WinterBayer AGFreie Universität Berlin robin.winter@bayer.com, Marco BertoliniBayer AG marco.bertolini@bayer.com Tuan LeBayer AGFreie Universität Berlin tuan.le2@bayer.com Frank NoéFreie Universität BerlinMicrosoft Research frank.noe@fu-berlin.de Djork-Arné ClevertBayer AG djork-arne.clevert@b
arxiv-2202-07559.description: Abstract Equivariant neural networks, whose hidden features transform according to representations of a group G G acting on the data, exhibit training efficiency and an improved generalisation performance. In this work, we extend group invariant and equivariant representation learning to the field of unsupervised deep learning.

arxiv-2212-01929.title: An Extremal Property of the Square Lattice Thanks: This work could not have been completed without the kind support of Jayadev Athreya and Stefan Steinerberger. This author would also like to thank Aisha Mechery and Albert Artiles for their thoughtful feedback.
arxiv-2212-01929.creator: Paige Helms
arxiv-2212-01929.description: Abstract . Motivated by a 2019 result of Faulhuber-Steinerberger [ 10 ] , we demonstrate that the real square lattice ℤ 2 \mathbb{Z}^{2} exhibits the same local, extremal property as the hexagonal lattice Λ \Lambda , where distances of lattice points from the ‘deep holes’ of natural fundamental domains increase under perturbation.

arxiv-2405-17902.title: Boosting Protein Language Models with Negative Sample Mining
arxiv-2405-17902.creator: Yaoyao Xu, Xinjian Zhao *, Xiaozhuang Song, Benyou Wang, Tianshu Yu(✉)
arxiv-2405-17902.description: Abstract We introduce a pioneering methodology for boosting large language models in the domain of protein representation learning. Our primary contribution lies in the refinement process for correlating the over-reliance on co-evolution knowledge, in a way that networks are trained to distill invaluable insights from negative samples, constituted by protein pairs sourced from disparate categories.

arxiv-2408-17244.title: Categorical data clustering: 25 years beyond K-modes
arxiv-2408-17244.creator: Tai Dinh, Wong Hauchi, Philippe Fournier-Viger, Daniil Lisik, Minh-Quyet Ha, Hieu-Chi Dam, Van-Nam Huynh
arxiv-2408-17244.description: Abstract The clustering of categorical data is a common and important task in computer science, offering profound implications across a spectrum of applications. Unlike purely numerical data, categorical data often lack inherent ordering as in nominal data, or have varying levels of order as in ordinal data, thus requiring specialized methodologies for efficient organization and analysis.

arxiv-2410-22140.title: Infrared photometry with InGaAs detectors: First light with SPECULOOS
arxiv-2410-22140.creator: Peter P. Pedersen, Didier Queloz, Lionel Garcia, Yannick Schacke, Laetitia Delrez, Brice-Olivier Demory, Elsa Ducrot, Georgina Dransfield, Michael Gillon, Matthew J. Hooton, Clàudia Janó-Muñoz, Emmanuël Jehin, Daniel Sebastian, Mathilde Timmermans, Samantha Thompson, Amaury H.M. J. Triaud, Julien de
arxiv-2410-22140.description: Abstract We present the photometric performance of SPIRIT, a ground-based near-infrared InGaAs CMOS-based instrument (1280 by 1024 pixels, 12 µ ​ m \mathrm{\SIUnitSymbolMicro m} pitch), using on-sky results from the SPECULOOS-Southern Observatory during 2022 – 2023. SPIRIT was specifically designed to optimise time-series photometric precision for observing late M and L type stars.

arxiv-2505-11071.title: Walsh-Floquet Theory of Periodic Kick Drives
arxiv-2505-11071.creator: James Walkling, Marin Bukov
arxiv-2505-11071.description: Abstract Periodic kick drives are ubiquitous in digital quantum control, computation, and simulation, and are instrumental in studies of chaos and thermalization for their efficient representation through discrete gates. However, in the commonly used Fourier basis, kick drives lead to poor convergence of physical quantities.

pmc-11476802.title: Multi-omics reveals lactylation-driven regulatory mechanisms promoting tumor progression in oral squamous cell carcinoma
pmc-11476802.creator: Fengyang Jing, Lijing Zhu, Jianyun Zhang, Xuan Zhou, Jiaying Bai, Xuefen Li, Heyu Zhang, Tiejun Li
pmc-11476802.description: BackgroundLactylation, a post-translational modification, is increasingly recognized for its role in cancer progression. This study investigates its prevalence and impact in oral squamous cell carcinoma (OSCC).ResultsImmunohistochemical staining of 81 OSCC cases shows lactylation levels correlate with malignancy grading. Proteomic analyses of six OSCC tissue pairs reveal 2765 lactylation sites on 1033 proteins, highlighting its extensive presence.

pmc-13111066.title: Arabic exercise assessment and screening for you tool: development, validation, and cultural adaptation among older adults in Saudi Arabia
pmc-13111066.creator: Saad M. Alsaad, Nasser M. AbuDujain, Norah Alrashoud, Nada Bin Obaid, Osama Abdulqader, Antoni Krupa, Barbara Resnick
pmc-13111066.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background and aimRegular physical activity is a key determinant of healthy aging; however, physical inactivity remains highly prevalent among older adults. Most existing screening tools emphasize risk assessment rather than providing individualized guidance for safe exercise. The Exercise Assessment and Screening for You (EASY) tool is an algorithm-based instrument designed to guide older adults toward appropriate physical activities based on their health conditions.

pmc-13193455.title: Views of the Swiss public towards gene editing
pmc-13193455.creator: Kelly E. Ormond, Sara Kijewski, Naomi Wyler, Agata Ferretti, Eirini Petrou, Claudia Reichmuth, Effy Vayena
pmc-13193455.description: There is little country-specific data about how the general public views gene editing therapies. In Autumn 2023 we randomly surveyed the Swiss public, using the Federal Register and stratifying by language region (German, French, Italian), gender and age. We present a representative sample of 3855 responses, including >4000 open-ended comments.

pmc-13321874.title: Microbiome and metabolites impact enteric and central nervous systems in ALS
pmc-13321874.creator: Erykah I Walton, Jun Sun
pmc-13321874.description: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) has been linked to gastrointestinal symptoms and alterations in the gut microbiota. The enteric nervous system (ENS) coordinates intestinal function and sits at the host–microbe interface. The mechanisms by which luminal changes relay to the central nervous system (CNS), where motor neurons reside, have yet to be completely defined.

pmc-13342341.title: Anti-PD-1 plus anti-CTLA-4 blockade overcomes immune exclusion in NSCLC brain metastases by enhancing CD8+ T cell responses and promoting tertiary lymphoid structure formation
pmc-13342341.creator: Kazutaka Hosoya, Hiroaki Ozasa, Takahiro Tsuji, Masahiro Oi, Yusuke Shima, Keiichiro Suminaga, Kentaro Hashimoto, Hiroshi Yoshida, Tomoko Funazo, Hitomi Ajimizu, Takashi Nomizo, Hironori Yoshida, Hiroyuki Katsuragawa, Kentaro Tsuji, Noritaka Sano, Shigeki Takada, Yohei Mineharu, Shigeto Nishikawa, T
pmc-13342341.description: Brain metastases (BrMs) in non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) respond poorly to anti-PD-1 monotherapy, but the underlying immune resistance remains incompletely defined. Here we integrate clinical outcome analyses, paired human tissue profiling and syngeneic mouse models to characterize the BrM immune microenvironment. Clinical analyses suggest improved intracranial disease control with nivolumab plus ipilimumab compared with nivolumab alone.

pmc-13451160.title: An Enclosed Nest Can Increase the Risk of Predation on Adults
pmc-13451160.creator: Yu Zhang, Huiyue Jiang, Yunwei Li, Kevin H. Mayo, Duo Liu, Mingju E
pmc-13451160.description: Even though enclosed nests provide a physical barrier for cavity‐nesting birds, nest predation is the primary cause of breeding failure and a major driver of avian population dynamics. Previous studies have largely focused on the loss of eggs and nestlings, whereas the predation risk faced by adult birds during the nestling‐rearing stage has received far less attention.
